context: Tests whether the agent writes Sequel database migrations correctly for a Hanami 2.x project. Checks use of the Sequel DSL (not ActiveRecord), correct column type names, null constraints, timezone-aware timestamps, reversibility conventions, and alter_table usage.

checklist.name: Sequel.migration wrapper
checklist.description: Every migration file uses the `Sequel.migration do ... end` wrapper (NOT a Rails-style class inheriting from ActiveRecord::Migration)

checklist.name: change block for reversible ops
checklist.description: The create_events and create_tickets migrations use a `change { }` block (NOT `up { }` / `down { }`) since create_table is reversible

checklist.name: up/down for drop_column
checklist.description: The migration that removes `draft_notes` uses explicit `up { }` and `down { }` blocks — NOT a `change { }` block — because drop_column is irreversible in Sequel

checklist.name: alter_table for add_description
checklist.description: Adding the `description` column to events uses `alter_table(:events) { add_column :description, ... }` — NOT the ActiveRecord-style `add_column :events, :description, ...` outside of an alter_table block

checklist.name: Sequel column type names
checklist.description: Text columns use `:text` type (NOT `:string`). Numeric columns use `:integer` or `:decimal`/`:numeric`. No ActiveRecord type names like `:string`, `:datetime` appear.

checklist.name: null: false on required columns
checklist.description: All required (non-nullable) columns declare `null: false` explicitly. At a minimum: events.title, events.venue, events.capacity, events.start_time, tickets.holder_name, tickets.holder_email, tickets.status must have `null: false`.

checklist.name: timestamptz for timestamps
checklist.description: Timestamp columns (created_at, updated_at, start_time, end_time, purchased_at) use `:timestamptz` type — NOT `:timestamp` or `:datetime`

checklist.name: primary_key declaration
checklist.description: Both tables declare a primary key using `primary_key :id` inside `create_table` (NOT `t.primary_key` or omitted)

checklist.name: Foreign key for tickets→events
checklist.description: The tickets table includes a foreign key column referencing the events table (e.g., `foreign_key :event_id, :events` or an integer column named `:event_id` with a reference)

checklist.name: Status enum constraint
checklist.description: The tickets.status column is defined as `:text` with `null: false` and a default or check constraint is present (OR the skill-preferred pattern of column + constraint is used to restrict values to reserved/confirmed/cancelled)

checklist.name: No ActiveRecord class syntax
checklist.description: No migration file contains `class ... < ActiveRecord::Migration`, `ActiveRecord::Schema`, or `add_column :table, :col, :type` outside of an `alter_table` block
